data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage__Part_1_1
data.value: The Pixelsorter App generally runs fully offline. All image processing (pixel sorting, masking, etc.) takes place exclusively on your local device. No images, usage data, or other personal data are transmitted to us or to third parties.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_2_HuggingFace
data.value: One-Time Model download from Hugging Face

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_2_1
data.value: A machine learning model is required for the automatic subject detection feature (subject masking). This model is downloaded once and only after explicit user interaction from the Hugging Face platform.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_2_2
data.value: When downloading the model, a network connection to Hugging Face servers is established. During this process, the following data may be transmitted to Hugging Face:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_2_3
data.value: • Your IP address • System information (user agent of the requesting client) • Time of the download

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_2_4
data.value: Data processing is carried out on the basis of your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), because the download is only triggered after your active interaction. You can revoke this consent for the future at any time by deleting the downloaded model in the app settings or by fully uninstalling the app from your device. Further information can be found in Hugging Face's privacy policy.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_2_5
data.value: After the one-time download, the model is stored locally in your device's file system. No further network connections to Hugging Face or other services are made afterwards.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_3_1
data.value: If you download the app through third-party platforms (e.g., Apple App Store, Google Play Store, Microsoft Store), these providers independently collect data (e.g., download statistics or crash reports). We have no influence over this data processing. The privacy policies of the respective store operators apply.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_4_1
data.value: The app contains no analytics tools, no tracking, and no advertising. No usage data is collected or shared with third parties.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_5_1
data.value: You have the right at any time to:

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_5_2
data.value: • Access your personal data stored by us (Art. 15 GDPR) • Rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR) • Erasure of your data stored by us (Art. 17 GDPR) • Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR) • Objection to processing (Art. 21 GDPR) • Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR) • Lodge a complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_6_CurrentValidityAndChangesToThisPrivacyPolicy
data.value: Current Validity and Changes to This Privacy Policy

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPage_Part_6_1
data.value: This privacy policy is currently valid and reflects the status as of March 2026. As the app evolves or due to changes in legal or regulatory requirements, it may become necessary to update this privacy policy.
